lines: Ae mohabbat tere anjaam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: O love, I wept at how you ended.

lines: Jaane kyun aaj tere naam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: I don't know why your name made me weep today.

lines: Yun to har shaam ummeedon mein guzar jaati thi
couplets.en: Every evening used to pass in hope.

lines: Aaj kuchh baat hai jo shaam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: Something was different today, and the evening moved me to tears.

lines: Kabhi taqdeer ka maatam kabhi duniya ka gila
couplets.en: Sometimes I mourned my fate, sometimes I blamed the world.

lines: Manzil-e-ishq mein har gaam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: On love's road, every step brought me to tears.

lines: Jab hua zikr zamaane mein mohabbat ka Shakeel
couplets.en: When people spoke of love, Shakeel, I thought of my own heart.

lines: Mujhko apne dil-e-naakaam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: I wept for my own disappointed heart.

lines: Ae mohabbat tere anjaam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: O love, I wept at how you ended.
